newsitem.title: UK: Amey unit awarded 26 mln stg UK MOD contract.
newsitem.headline: Amey unit awarded 26 mln stg UK MOD contract.

text.p: Britain's Amey Plc said on Wednesday its Amey Facilities Management (AFM) unit had been awarded a 26 million stg contract to manage the maintenance of the UK Ministry of Defence's Shropshire and Donnington group.
Amey, the British facilities management, maintenance and specialist construction group, said that the contract is for 42 months, but is extendible by a further 24 months.

Amey said in a statement that MOD Donnington, near Shrewsbury, central England, included Europe's largest fully-automated warehouse. AFM will be responsible for all property-related maintenance management, including new works.
The group now manages more than 60 MOD establishments.
